As part of a broader package for technological resilience and national security, the funding will also bolster the existing AI Security Institute, deploy a national cyber defense shield using agentic AI, and fund vulnerability detection infrastructure. Ministers describe the biosecurity facility as a world-first institute designed to keep pace with evolving technological and biological risks.

Grocery delivery platform Instacart is exploring a potential sale that could end its 14-year run as a standalone company. The company has engaged in preliminary discussions with potential buyers, including major competitors Uber and DoorDash.

entry.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Showcases Microduck Robots at GTC Berlin
entry.content:
Links: techcrunch.com | source

During his keynote at the Nvidia GTC Berlin conference, CEO Jensen Huang demonstrated Microduck, a small open-source bipedal robot developed by Pollen Robotics. Following the live demonstration, preorders for the $399 robot surpassed 20,000 units.

The 25-centimeter-tall robot features 15 motors, a camera, and an articulated beak, and was trained using Nvidia's simulation technology stack. Deliveries are scheduled ahead of the holiday season, positioning the device as a consumer-oriented robotic platform for physical artificial intelligence experimentation.

entry.title: Google Updates Privacy Policy to Permit Ad Targeting via Personal Intelligence Data
entry.content:
Links: theverge.com | source | hacker news

Google has updated its privacy policy to introduce an exception allowing personal data from services like Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Photos to be used for targeted advertising. The change applies when users connect these services to AI and search tools through Google's Personal Intelligence feature to receive personalized recommendations.

While advertisers do not gain direct access to the underlying personal files or identifying information, the update removes a previous blanket exclusion that protected these workspaces. Users can opt out of the ad targeting by disconnecting specific apps or disabling personalized recommendations through their account settings.
